data.why: The app streams Sentinel-2 imagery and NDVI history live from public STAC/S3 endpoints at runtime; there is no local example dataset to seed, and search/streaming/pixel-history all work anonymously against the public hosts listed below.

goals: Search the Copernicus catalogue for Sentinel-2 scenes over a location and date range by cloud cover and product type
Scan the coloured MGRS coverage grid to see how many Sentinel-2 L2A scenes cover each tile per month
Click a tile to stream its latest true-colour image and browse contextual overlays (land cover, NDVI climatology, soil moisture, DEM, burned area)
Click a point on the map to chart its Sentinel-2 NDVI history over months or years, with cloudy readings flagged
Export a point's NDVI time series as CSV for further analysis
Use the Point Inspector to read the exact land-cover class, NDVI, temperature or elevation value under the cursor

review.summary: The tree covers the discovery half of vresto well, in a sensible order: set place and time, run a filtered search, read the coverage grid, pick a scene, and chart and export a point's NDVI series. Every cited screen I opened matches its node, and the failures are reported honestly. It leaves out retrieval (band and resolution download), the overlays, and the Point Inspector, all of which the README presents as core, so it needs those added as not-reached nodes, plus small label and data-source fixes, before filing.
